Riffclash

Giant beasts in the city are stuck in big feelings. As Crew Captain, use music to help them. Pick your difficulty, then select a game mode.

Difficulty

🗺️

Campaign

Use music to help the beasts

  1. Read the scouting report and name how the beast feels.
  2. Pick the riff that matches its mood.
  3. Play the beat. The music shifts, and so does the beast.
  4. Talk to it and invite it into your crew.
🥁

Beat Lab

1 or 2 players · more levels + make your own beat

New!
  1. Play more rhythm game levels, from slow grooves to fast ones.
  2. Pick Rookie, Pro or Legend (then Nightmare, if you dare), and hit the notes on the beat.
  3. Play solo, or grab a friend and share one keyboard: Team up or Face-off.
  4. Make your own beat, then play it as a rhythm game level.

🔒 Help one beast in the Campaign to unlock the Beat Lab.

Switch player when it's someone else's turn. Start over clears this captain's progress and coins, and keeps the captain's free look and saved beats.

Beast beats

Make a beat

Beat name

Tap the squares to add hits. BOOM is the kick drum, CLAP is the snare, TSS is the hi-hat. In the rhythm game, your BOOMs and CLAPs become notes, and on Legend your TSS hits do too.

    How the music changed

    Beat editor

    Dev only. Changes save in this browser and change the game here right away. Nobody else hears them until you copy the beats and send them to be built in.

    Drums: one bar, 16 steps. Kick notes become BOOM, snare notes become CLAP, off-beat hi-hats become TSS on Legend.

    Share or restore beats

    Who's playing?

    Games are saved on this computer only. Nothing is sent anywhere.

    Your Crew Captain

    You lead the crew. Pick your look, or hit Randomize. You can change it later from the map.

    🎟️ Got a coin ticket? If you won coins as a Guest on a friend's computer, type the 4-character ticket here to add the coins to your captain. (This is not your captain code.)

    🔓 Beat Lab unlocked! More rhythm game levels, plus make your own beat and play it. Find it on the menu.
